# Xavier Yu & Associates, CPA

Xavier Yu & Associates, CPA is a tax and accounting firm in Woodland Hills, California.
The founder is Xavier Yuchongtian, CPA, with over 20 years of tax and accounting experience.
The firm prepares individual, partnership, LLC, S corporation, and C corporation tax returns.
The firm provides small business accounting, bookkeeping, and payroll services.
The firm sets up QuickBooks, trains owners, and tunes up existing books.
The firm represents clients before the IRS and California tax agencies.
The office is at 21021 Ventura Boulevard, Suite 350, Woodland Hills, CA 91364.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Saturday and Sunday closed.
Phone: (818) 530-1091. Email: xavier@xaviercpa.com.
Call for a free initial consultation.
